verdicts.reason: A shrinks the hero bottle to a tiny speck stranded at the bottom edge, which effectively deletes the product. It also moves and enlarges the 'WEEKEND ONLY' eyebrow below the body copy, so the reading order is scrambled, and the bottom of the canvas is wasted space. B keeps the bottle at a readable size and in the right order (copy, then product, then CTA), but the copy block is crammed against the left edge with a tiny margin, the headline is shrunk, and the left-aligned text sits awkwardly above the centred bottle and button; the eyebrow is also still moved below the body.
